caption: The drawing shows a large decorative hair comb positioned at the top center of the composition. The comb is light beige with brown and gold tones, and features a floral pattern with leaves and stylized flowers, created using various shades of reddish-brown and yellow. The upper part of the comb has a scalloped outline that follows the contours of the floral design, while the lower portion displays nine evenly spaced, tapered teeth that are slightly darker toward the tips. Below the colored comb, there is a simple line sketch in pencil showing the outline and basic shape of the same comb, including the scalloped top and a few comb teeth, positioned at a slight angle. The bottom left corner of the paper has the name "John H. Tercuzzi" lightly written in small letters. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present.
title: Comb
